rule_name: Employee submit-only travel access
description: employee can submit travel requests but cannot approve them.
validator_message: Employee cannot approve travel or reimbursement requests.
llm_prompt_instruction: Do not generate approval tools for employee role.
healing_guidance: Route approval to department_manager or finance_manager.

rule_name: Department manager travel approval
description: department_manager can approve employee travel requests if not self-approving.
validator_message: Department manager approval required for travel permit.
llm_prompt_instruction: Use department_manager for permit approval.
healing_guidance: Request department manager approval.

rule_name: Permit before declaration
description: Travel permit must be approved before travel declaration.
validator_message: Travel declaration requires approved travel permit.
llm_prompt_instruction: Generate permit approval before declaration.
healing_guidance: Reorder candidate.

rule_name: Declaration before reimbursement
description: Travel declaration must be completed before reimbursement.
validator_message: Reimbursement requires completed travel declaration.
llm_prompt_instruction: Generate declaration before reimbursement claim.
healing_guidance: Reorder candidate.

rule_name: High-value reimbursement approval
description: Reimbursement amount above 50000 LKR requires department manager and finance approval.
validator_message: High-value reimbursement requires department manager and finance approval.
llm_prompt_instruction: Add department and finance approval steps.
healing_guidance: Insert request_department_manager_approval and request_finance_reimbursement_approval.

rule_name: Employee cannot approve own reimbursement
description: Employee cannot approve own reimbursement.
validator_message: Employee cannot approve own reimbursement.
llm_prompt_instruction: Use independent approver for reimbursement.
healing_guidance: Assign department_manager or finance_manager.

rule_name: Travel request required fields
description: Missing employee_id, destination, start_date, end_date, or amount blocks travel execution.
validator_message: Travel workflow is missing employee, destination, dates, or amount.
llm_prompt_instruction: Ask for missing travel fields.
healing_guidance: Request employee_id, destination, start_date, end_date, and amount.

rule_name: Travel future schema capability gap
description: Travel tools are recommended future capabilities unless ERPBridge schema exists.
validator_message: Travel ERPBridge schema is missing for requested tool.
llm_prompt_instruction: Generate capability request instead of direct travel execution.
healing_guidance: Use capability.create_capability_request.

rule_name: Missing travel endpoint capability request
description: If travel endpoint or schema is missing, create capability request instead of execution.
validator_message: Travel endpoint/schema missing; direct execution not allowed.
llm_prompt_instruction: Route to capability request.
healing_guidance: Create capability request with missing endpoint detail.

rule_name: Travel writes require audit
description: All travel and reimbursement write operations must write an audit log.
validator_message: Travel write workflow requires audit logging.
llm_prompt_instruction: Append audit.write_audit_log to travel write workflows.
healing_guidance: Add audit log step.
